reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: sync path (request_manager.nim:176-194) only calls verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof, never verify_data_column_sidecar. Gossip path correctly validates via verify_data_column_sidecar (gossip_validation.nim:596, peerdas_helpers.nim:362-364) which checks array length equality. Block processor calls verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs (block_processor.nim:254,687) which passes arrays to verifyCellKzgProofBatch WITHOUT pre-validation. Spec requirement from 01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json line 245-260: 'Column, kzg_commitments, and kzg_proofs arrays must all have equal length' is NOT enforced on sync path. Classified as CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL not CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY because actual exploitability depends on verifyCellKzgProofBatch library behavior (may gracefully handle or crash). Severity downgraded to Low: Nimbus-specific bug with <10% network share, below Medium threshold (>5%).
